display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.5 Join Reverse → Settlement Reconciliation
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.5 Join Reverse → Settlement Reconciliation
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  r.sub_order_num,
  r.charged_amount AS reverse_oms_amount,
  r.order_status AS reverse_status,
  s.settled_amount AS settlement_payout,
  s.return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax AS return_logistics,
  s.order_status AS settlement_status
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse r
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_settlement s
  ON r.sub_order_num = s.order_id
  AND s.is_active = true
WHERE r.is_active = true;
